# Loading in the cleaned and split data
```{r}
madness_train <- readRDS("training_data.rds")
madness_test <- readRDS("testing_data.rds")
```

# Create Random Forest Model and Display Variable Importance Plot
```{r}
library(randomForest)

set.seed(12345)
rf_model <- randomForest(as.factor(winner) ~ ., data = madness_train, ntree = 100)

importance(rf_model)

varImpPlot(rf_model)
```

# Test Random Forest Model
```{r}
# probability that team 1 wins
rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, madness_test, type = "prob")[, "1"]

head(rf_pred)
```

# Create Confusion Matrix for Random Forest Model
```{r}
library(caret)

rf_confusion <- confusionMatrix(
  factor(ifelse(rf_pred > 0.5, 1, 0), levels = c(0, 1)),
  as.factor(madness_test$winner),
  positive = "1"
)

rf_confusion
```

# Saving relevant data files
```{r}
saveRDS(rf_pred, "rf_stacked_probability.rds")
saveRDS(rf_confusion, "rf_confusion.rds")

```
